question: Should this PR be allowed to introduce the bundled dashboard state/history stack on JSON sidecars with an external dependency graph change, or should it wait for the Wave 1 dashboard stack to be reworked and approved first?
rationale: The remaining blockers are not a narrow code repair: they require maintainer product/storage direction plus security approval for dependency and custom-widget surfaces before this feature can be considered merge-ready.

options.title: Require Stack Cleanup First
options.body: Keep the PR open but require the dashboard base, storage model, dependency approval, and proof gaps to be resolved before reviewing this as a landing candidate.

options.title: Approve A Narrow Exception
options.body: A maintainer/security owner may explicitly accept the JSON state and dependency graph exceptions for this stack and require focused upgrade/security proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Behind The Base PR
options.body: Treat this as blocked until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101098 or a replacement dashboard base is mergeable and proof-positive.

recommendation.title: Require Stack Cleanup First
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but require the dashboard base, storage model, dependency approval, and proof gaps to be resolved before reviewing this as a landing candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily product direction around dashboard auditability and Logbook linkage, which is closest to the merged Logbook feature history.
